The Smith community comes together for events throughout the year. From the first Rally Day in 1876, to Julia Child Day and the Sherrerd Teaching Prizes, begun in 2004, the college's annual events honor our students, faculty and alumnae for their accomplishments; bring families to campus for a taste of college life; and give students an opportunity to learn, reflect or just have fun.

Inclement Weather/Cancellation Policy

Should the College have a delayed opening or be closed due to inclement weather, you may reschedule your event with us pending availability of space, or choose to cancel your event and have your deposit refunded.

For information about delayed openings, or weather emergency information, please call the Smith Information Line at 413-585-4636.

An updated announcement of storm delays or closings will be available beginning approximately at 6:30 a.m. on the affected workday.
